description: Fibre Exemplars (Chemistry) is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Solicitor General. This database contains information on natural fibres. The descriptions include fibre code, fibre trade name, source and treatment. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Solicitor General. Its tags are Gouvernement, Government, Justice and Public Safety, Justice et sécurité publique. The portal shows 2021-01-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
